verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat lets users query meetings, CRM data, and generate follow-ups using natural language, and the MCP server extends this to external AI assistants like ChatGPT/Claude for natural-language querying of meeting data. This is a clear match for AI-native natural-language operation, though evidence is entirely first-party marketing with no hands-on or independent confirmation of the chat/command experience. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, and detail on the range/limits of commands supported.
